name: Rusty Sword
description: A battered sword, barely fit for battle. Better than nothing.
flavor_text: Every legend had a first weapon.

name: Iron Sword
description: A reliable iron sword. Standard military issue.

name: Mage's Staff
description: A gnarled wooden staff capped with a mana crystal. Focuses magical energy.
flavor_text: Wood remembers what it once was: alive.

name: Enchanted Blade
description: A sword humming with contained magical energy. In the right hands, the boundary between sword and spell dissolves.
flavor_text: The runes were carved by someone who understood both arts.

name: Shadow Daggers
description: Twin daggers that seem to absorb light. They strike before the eye can track them.
flavor_text: Speed is the only armor a rogue needs.
